author: @DeepankarSandhibigraha
comment_text: Brother, I'm using a core 2 duo with 4gb ram 2009 laptop to run immich. Ofcourse, I ran ML on a remote machine, macbook air m4, still cpu only. I also added 50k images as external library. It took 2-3 hours to run the ML. But after that it's fine for 2-3 client device usage. Unless you're uploading 100s of images daily, it'll handle all services on that laptop as nightly runs. I setup ssd as the db, thumbnail etc storage and upload location as hdd added to optical bay using a caddy. It's not optimal solution for safe backup but I have my original image backed up on another hdd. I also keep weekly backup of immmich db dump on separate system. Ideal server should have raid setup for redundancy. And also 3-2-1 rule for backup
